card0_gpu_busy_percent.description: Shows how much the GPU is actively processing graphics workloads

card1_gpu_busy_percent.description: Shows how much the GPU is actively processing graphics workloads

card0_gtt_utilization_percent.alias: GPU 0 shared graphics memory usage percentage
card0_gtt_utilization_percent.description: Tracks usage of system RAM allocated for GPU operations

card1_gtt_utilization_percent.alias: GPU 1 shared graphics memory usage percentage
card1_gtt_utilization_percent.description: Tracks usage of system RAM allocated for GPU operations

card0_gpu_clock_mhz.alias: GPU 0 current clock frequency in MHz
card0_gpu_clock_mhz.description: Indicates the GPU's operating speed for graphics processing

card1_gpu_clock_mhz.alias: GPU 1 current clock frequency in MHz
card1_gpu_clock_mhz.description: Indicates the GPU's operating speed for graphics processing

card0_gpu_power_milliwatts.alias: GPU 0 current power consumption in mW
card0_gpu_power_milliwatts.description: Shows how much electrical power the GPU is currently using

card1_gpu_power_milliwatts.alias: GPU 1 current power consumption in mW
card1_gpu_power_milliwatts.description: Shows how much electrical power the GPU is currently using

card0_gpu_memory_clock_mhz.alias: GPU 0 memory clock frequency in MHz
card0_gpu_memory_clock_mhz.description: Indicates the speed of GPU video memory operations

card1_gpu_memory_clock_mhz.alias: GPU 1 memory clock frequency in MHz
card1_gpu_memory_clock_mhz.description: Indicates the speed of GPU video memory operations

cpu_usage_percent.description: Shows how much CPU capacity is currently being used across all processors

cpu_count_logical.alias: Total number of logical CPU cores
cpu_count_logical.description: Indicates the total count of logical processors available in the system

memory_total_bytes.description: Indicates the total amount of physical memory installed in the system

memory_used_bytes.description: Shows the amount of memory currently being used by processes and kernel

memory_free_bytes.description: Indicates the amount of memory that is completely unused

memory_active_bytes.description: Shows memory that is actively being used by processes

memory_inactive_bytes.description: Indicates memory that is available for immediate reuse

memory_buffers_bytes.description: Shows memory used for I/O buffers

memory_cached_bytes.description: Indicates memory used for file system cache

memory_shared_bytes.description: Shows memory that is shared between processes

memory_slab_bytes.description: Indicates kernel data structure cache memory

memory_usage_percent.description: Indicates how much of the available memory is currently in use

disk_usage_percent.description: Shows how much of the system drive is occupied with data and applications

cpu_frequency_mhz.alias: Current CPU operating frequency in MHz
cpu_frequency_mhz.description: Indicates the actual speed at which the processor is running

cpu_context_switches_voluntary.description: Counts CPU task switches when processes voluntarily yield control

cpu_interrupts.description: Counts CPU task switches forced by the system due to resource constraints

memory_available_mb.description: Shows how much RAM is currently free for new applications and processes

swap_usage_percent.description: Indicates how much of the virtual memory (page file/swap) is currently in use

swap_used_mb.description: Shows the amount of virtual memory currently being used on disk

network_bytes_sent.description: Cumulative count of data sent out through all network interfaces

network_bytes_received.description: Cumulative count of data received through all network interfaces

disk_read_count.description: Counts the number of times data has been read from the storage device

disk_write_count.description: Counts the number of times data has been written to the storage device

disk_read_bytes.description: Cumulative number of bytes read from all storage devices

disk_write_bytes.description: Cumulative number of bytes written to all storage devices

disk_read_time_ms.alias: Total disk read time in milliseconds
disk_read_time_ms.description: Cumulative time spent reading data from all storage devices

disk_write_time_ms.alias: Total disk write time in milliseconds
disk_write_time_ms.description: Cumulative time spent writing data to all storage devices

fan_speed_amdgpu.alias: GPU fan speed - rotational speed of the graphics card cooling fan in RPM
fan_speed_amdgpu.description: Fan speed reading from amdgpu sensor

top_process_1.alias: Top CPU and memory consuming process 1
top_process_1.description: The process currently consuming the most CPU and/or memory resources
